instruction: A candid documentary medium shot captures a ballet class inside a softly lit studio. On the left, the female ballet instructor in a black bodysuit (R1) stands in profile, leaning forward to guide the young ballet student in a black tutu (R2) on the right. The instructor (R1) gently supports the student's (R2) leg with one hand while guiding her arm with the other to adjust her posture. The student (R2) faces left, smiling warmly at her teacher. In the background, a grey wall, a wooden ballet barre, and warm overhead string lights create a soft, focused atmosphere with gentle shadows.
